sourceQuote: The degree courses are: Advanced Mathematics, Elementary Chinese, Intermediate Chinese, College Physics, Circuit Analysis, Foundation of Electrical Machinery & Towage, Analog Electronic Technology, Digital Electronic Technology, Principle of Automatic Control, Electrical Power Engineering, Principleof, Power Electronics, Electrical Power Towage Automatic Control System.
targetQuote: 学位课程包括：高等数学、初级汉语、中级汉语、大学物理、电路分析、电机与拖动基础、模拟电子技术、数字电子技术、自动控制原理、电气工程原理、功率电子原理、电气拖动自动控制系统。
